<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Game reset. Let me try a new strategy.
# First, let me click all 7 green blocks and see if that completes the level

seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")

# Build click list
clicks = []
for gn in green_nodes:
    b = gn['boundary']
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in b) // len(b)
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in b) // len(b)
    clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})
    print(f"  Click at ({center_r}, {center_c})")

# Click all green blocks
result = action(clicks)
print(f"\nAfter clicks: done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check remaining green blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"Remaining green: {len(green_nodes)}")

# If level not complete, try moving to passage and pressing ACTION7
if not last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
    # Find character
    char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
    char_col = sum(p[1] for p in char['boundary']) // len(char['boundary'])
    print(f"\nCharacter at col ~{char_col}")
    
    # Move to passage (cols 38-42)
    # From current position, move right until at passage
    for i in range(10):
        result = action(['RIGHT'])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
        char_col = sum(p[1] for p in char['boundary']) // len(char['boundary'])
        print(f"After RIGHT #{i+1}: char at col ~{char_col}")
        if char_col >= 39:  # Near passage
            break
    
    # Press ACTION7 at passage
    result = action(['ACTION7'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
    char_pos = char['boundary']
    char_r = sum(p[0] for p in char_pos) // len(char_pos)
    char_c = sum(p[1] for p in char_pos) // len(char_pos)
    print(f"\nAfter ACTION7 at passage: char at ({char_r}, {char_c})")
    print(f"Done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
